{{EventSandboxOnly|date=28th of May 2022|event=[[Duck Hunt Event]]}} {{SameName|Spy Ducky|'''D00M's Revenge''' • [[Spy Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky Revenge]]}}{{For|other uses of [[Duck (Disambiguation)|Duck]]}} {{Zombie |image1 = Spy Ducky.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]] |first_wave_appearance = 7 ([[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]16Beyond wave 15, '''Spy Ducky''' scaled its health with time. |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (3.5) |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |spawned_by = [[Eggroll]] |title1=Spy Ducky}} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Spy Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had low health and an above average speed. It was also a hidden enemy. Beyond wave 15, its health would increase over time. The '''Spy Ducky''' could be spawned by the [[Eggroll]]. ==Appearance== The '''Spy Ducky''' is a black translucent duck with black eyes and an orange beak and feet. It has a piece of paper with a head of a yellow humanoid drawn on it. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *Towers with cheap hidden detection like the [[Soldier]] and [[Golden Scout]] fare well against the '''Spy Ducky'''. **Multiple [[Sniper]]s are recommended for their long range. In addition, the [[Sniper]] can also counter the [[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]] that debuts later on in the game. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDRSpyDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Spring Trailer|'''Spy Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacySpyDuckyIconIG.png|'''Spy Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The piece of paper on the '''Spy Ducky's''' head is a reference to the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Spy Spy] from ''Team Fortress 2'', more precisely the disguise mask teammates can see on a disguised [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Spy Spy]. ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Spy Ducky''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Spy Ducky''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Spy Ducky''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Spy Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Spy Ducky]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge|[[Fat Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Fat Ducky]]|Wave 5|Spy Ducky|Wave 7|[[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Mother Ducky]]|Wave 8}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Spy Ducky}}
